title: Miracle Mountain Ranch

services.name: Day Camp
services.desc: Miracle Mountain Ranch offers Adventure Camps for young buckaroos from 6 to 9, as well as for those aging from 8 to 16. Adventure Camps come packed with a variety of activities ranging from trail rides to swimming, with outdoor sports like paintball, Octaball, basketball, soccer, capture the flag, and many other creative and fun games your kids will enjoy for the week. If you are looking to experience a week of summer camp but would rather not commit to overnight camp, then a week of Day Camp might be just what you are looking for. Our all-new Wild West Day Camp runs in conjunction with our classic Wild West camps and is packed with classic MMR activities that get Ranchers out in the fresh
